segment.description: Sale Creek (GNIS 01300534, HUC-8 06020001) in Hamilton County: a named Chickamauga Lake tributary near the community of Sale Creek. The agency temperature record cited below is from TDEC station TDECWPC-SALE001.2HM at river-mile 1.2 (35.3667, -85.0678), i.e. the lower creek approaching its Chickamauga Reservoir embayment; the upper course is unmeasured in any source found.
segment.boundaries: Hamilton County creek draining north-to-south into the Chickamauga Lake arm near Sale Creek, TN; full named creek per catalog (no dam upstream of it on this water).

coldSource.notes: No dam or cold-release regime exists on the creek itself; the lower reach is an embayment of TVA's Chickamauga Reservoir, whose TWRA fishery account is a warmwater gamefish fishery (largemouth, smallmouth, striped bass, bluegill, redear, walleye, sauger, crappie, catfish) with no trout fishery documented.

holdover.detail: No holdover record found and no trout program exists on the creek, so no carryover question has been surveyed or reported by any acceptable source.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout presence documented: zero hits for 'Sale Creek' on TWRA's trout-regulations page (no wild-trout, special-regulation, or delayed-harvest listing) and zero rows in TWRA's 2026 stocking schedule ('Sale Creek' — 0 hits in the live exceldriven JSON and the repo workbook). USGS historic stations 03566292/03566297 confirm the creek's identity and reach but hold no trout records.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TDEC monitoring 1.2 miles above the creek's Chickamauga Lake embayment recorded 29.0 degC in August 1999 and 28.2 degC in July — classic warmwater embayment-creek temperatures with no trout program of any kind.
